summary.goal: When an agent has a new question (state changes to needs_input), show a mini chat bubble above their avatar in the status bar displaying a truncated preview of the question. Auto-dismiss after 5 seconds. Click to open triage panel. Queue multiple notifications to show one at a time.
in_scope: useQuestionNotifications hook to manage notification queue
Extend AgentAvatar with notification props (notificationContent, showNotification)
Mini bubble rendered via AgentAvatar's tooltip infrastructure
Click to open triage panel with that question selected

acceptance_criteria.description: When agent state changes to needs_input, a mini bubble appears above their avatar in the status bar
Bubble displays truncated question text (max ~50 characters with ellipsis)
Bubble shows agent role icon and blocking level badge
Bubble auto-dismisses after 5 seconds
Clicking the bubble opens the triage panel with that question selected
Multiple notifications are queued and shown one at a time (5s each)
Notification has slide-up entrance and fade-out exit animation
Bubble positioned correctly above the relevant agent's avatar (uses tooltip positioning)

architecture.description: Extend AgentAvatar to support auto-display notification mode, with queue logic in a dedicated hook

components.name: useQuestionNotifications
components.responsibility: Manage notification queue - listen for question_added events, queue them, expose current notification and dismiss function, auto-advance after 5 seconds

components.name: AgentAvatar (extended)
components.responsibility: New props: notificationContent (ReactNode), showNotification (boolean). When showNotification=true, render mini bubble instead of hover tooltip using same positioning infrastructure

components.name: Layout/StatusBar
components.responsibility: Use useQuestionNotifications to get current notification, pass notificationContent and showNotification=true to the matching AgentAvatar

bubble_styling.borderRadius: rounded-xl rounded-bl-sm (speech bubble tail toward avatar)

bubble_content.header: flex items-center gap-1.5 - role icon (text-xs) + blocking badge

blocking_badges.hard_block: bg-error/20 text-error text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded
blocking_badges.soft_block: bg-warning/20 text-warning text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded
blocking_badges.preference: bg-warning/20 text-warning text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded
blocking_badges.fyi: bg-accent-cyan/20 text-accent-cyan text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded

plan_implementation.approach: Extend AgentAvatar with notification mode, queue logic in useQuestionNotifications hook

steps.title: Create useQuestionNotifications hook
steps.description: Create hook at packages/planner-ui/src/hooks/useQuestionNotifications.ts that manages the notification queue. Listen to question_added events from useQuestionQueue, queue new questions, expose current notification with 5-second auto-advance timer.

acceptance_criteria.description: Hook returns { currentNotification: { question: Question, agentId: string } | null, dismiss: () => void, queue: Question[] }
When question_added event fires, question is added to queue
Current notification auto-advances to next in queue after 5 seconds
dismiss() immediately removes current notification and advances queue
Hook accepts optional onNotificationClick callback

steps.title: Create QuestionNotificationContent component
steps.description: Create component at packages/planner-ui/src/components/QuestionNotificationContent.tsx that renders the mini bubble content (role icon, blocking badge, truncated question text). This will be passed as notificationContent to AgentAvatar.

acceptance_criteria.description: Component accepts { question: Question, onClick: () => void }
Displays role icon from getRoleConfig(question.agent_role)
Displays blocking level badge with correct color per design_spec.bubble_content.blocking_badges
Displays question.text truncated to 50 chars with ellipsis
Entire component is clickable (cursor-pointer, onClick handler)
Styling matches design_spec.bubble_styling (max-w-64, px-3 py-2, bg-bg-tertiary, border-border-subtle, rounded-xl rounded-bl-sm, shadow-lg)

steps.title: Extend AgentAvatar with notification mode
steps.description: Add new props to AgentAvatar: notificationContent (ReactNode), showNotification (boolean), onNotificationClick (() => void). When showNotification=true, render the Tooltip in open state with notificationContent instead of default tooltip content.

acceptance_criteria.description: AgentAvatar accepts notificationContent?: ReactNode prop
AgentAvatar accepts showNotification?: boolean prop (default false)
AgentAvatar accepts onNotificationClick?: () => void prop
When showNotification=true, Tooltip is forced open with notificationContent
When showNotification=true, clicking avatar OR bubble calls onNotificationClick
Tooltip has animate-in/animate-out classes per design_spec.animations
Normal hover tooltip behavior preserved when showNotification=false

steps.title: Integrate into Layout component
steps.description: In Layout.tsx, use useQuestionNotifications hook. Pass notification data to StatusBar. StatusBar passes notificationContent and showNotification to the matching AgentAvatar. When notification is clicked, call setSelectedQuestionId and setTriagePanelOpen.

acceptance_criteria.description: Layout uses useQuestionNotifications hook
StatusBar receives currentNotification prop with { agentId, content, onClick }
StatusBar passes showNotification=true and notificationContent to AgentAvatar where agent.id matches currentNotification.agentId
Clicking notification calls setSelectedQuestionId(question.question_id) and opens triage panel
Notification dismisses and queue advances correctly

steps.title: Add animation keyframes to globals.css
steps.description: Ensure animate-in, animate-out, fade-in-0, fade-out-0, slide-in-from-bottom-2 are defined in globals.css for the notification bubble animations.

acceptance_criteria.description: Animation classes animate-in fade-in-0 slide-in-from-bottom-2 duration-200 work for enter
Animation classes animate-out fade-out-0 duration-300 work for exit

steps.title: Write tests for useQuestionNotifications hook
steps.description: Create test file packages/planner-ui/src/hooks/useQuestionNotifications.test.ts with tests for queue management, auto-advance timing, dismiss behavior.

acceptance_criteria.description: Test: adding question to queue shows it as currentNotification
Test: after 5 seconds, queue advances to next notification
Test: dismiss() advances queue immediately
Test: multiple questions queue correctly (FIFO)
Test: onNotificationClick callback fires when provided
